annotations.title: Before Your Agent Gets a Phone Number

description: For a business putting an agent with its own email or phone number in front of customers. Track record and pre-hire check on the agent, a prompt-injection scan of its system prompt and tools when you send them, then a signed delegation record naming the actions it must get a human to confirm first (refunds, outbound email, ...). Stops before the record on an AVOID verdict or a flagged scan. BlindOracle signs and publishes the policy; it does not sit in the agent's phone or mail path and does not enforce it. Attach a person grant to cap spend and revoke it in one call. One payment; unexecuted steps refunded. (x402: $0.77 USDC per call)
name: bundle.smb-agent-guardrails
